_doc: Wilderness set pieces, round 4 (ADR-0053): the Kettle Creek backcountry ranger station (pois/buildings/w4_backcountry_ranger_station.json). Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild4_ranger.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild4_ranger.py. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. The tower's lattice sections, piers and cab centre on the tower's axis (the middle of its 2 x 2 landings); the cab shell's origin is on the cab's floor.

defs.name: Tower Lattice Section
defs.description: One 3 m storey of the fire-weather tower's galvanised lattice: four angle legs, girts, X-bracing on every face and the landing frame under the next level. Stacked one per kit level round the POI's landings; origin on the tower's axis.

defs.name: Tower Piers
defs.description: The fire-weather tower's four concrete piers with their anchor bolts and base plates.

defs.name: Tower Cab
defs.description: The steel-clad cab on top of the fire-weather tower round the POI's 2 x 2 kit room (origin on its floor, at the room's centre): ribbed green panels cut for a window each side, storm shutters propped open, the floor frame, a whip antenna and the lightning conductor. The kit roof is its hip.

defs.name: Stevenson Screen
defs.description: A white louvred instrument shelter on four legs with a double roof, the thermometers and the hygrograph inside (destroyed: pushed over on its back).

defs.name: Rain Gauge
defs.description: The standard 8-inch rain gauge in its ring stand on a cedar post, the measuring stick clipped beside it.

defs.name: Anemometer Mast
defs.description: A 10 m guyed pipe mast with the cup anemometer and the wind vane on its cross arm and the junction box at chest height.

defs.name: Brush Truck
defs.description: The district's Type 6 brush engine: a green crew-cab one-ton with a white roof, brush guard and winch bumper, light bar, the water tank, pump, hose reel and side lockers on the bed (destroyed: burnt out).

defs.name: Checkpoint Barrier
defs.description: A striped barrier arm across the road on its counterweighted pivot post and a fork post, the Cordon's STOP / CHECKPOINT board hung under it (destroyed: the arm snapped).

defs.name: Fuel Tank Stand
defs.description: A red 300-gallon fuel tank on a welded stand over a drip tray, the gravity hose and nozzle on its hook, a rotary hand pump on the leg and an extinguisher (destroyed: a leg buckled, the hose cut).

defs.name: Compound Gate (open)
defs.description: The compound's double chain-link gate with both leaves swung back inside the fence (-Z) and left open, the chain and open padlock hanging off a post. The way in is the gap between the posts: place it route_ok.

defs.name: Gun Safe
defs.description: A dark green steel gun safe with a combination dial, a three-spoke handle and a keyed lock (destroyed: pried open).

defs.name: Fire Danger Sign
defs.description: The fire danger rating board on two posts under a little cedar roof: the five-band half-dial with its arrow left on EXTREME.
